description: Per-directory coverage floors enforced directly in CI from the Cobertura report that
dotnet test produces. These are the authoritative floors for this repository.
The equivalent targets in codecov.yml are for dashboards and PR comments only;
Codecov has never successfully processed a report for this project, so nothing there
Each floor sits roughly a point below measured coverage so it ratchets against
regression without blocking current work. Raise a floor when its directory improves.
Branch percentages are computed from Cobertura condition outcomes, deduplicating
lines that appear under more than one class.

directories.rationale: Holds the DO-178C and NPR 7150.2 evidence gates. Measured 91.52% line, 75.25% branch.

rationale: Line coverage is low because most of this directory is hardcoded specification
data and console-printing demo scaffolding with no decisions in it. Branch
coverage is the meaningful number here and it went from 0% to 50.29%: the
compliance checks, the mission-level requirement tables, and the readiness
thresholds are the code that actually decides something, and those are now
verified. Hold the branch floor even if the line floor stays modest.

directories.rationale: Largest directory at 8021 lines. Measured 44.91% line, 32.41% branch.

rationale: Branch coverage went from 0% to 41.03% by verifying the reinforcement-learning
controller's value update, reward shaping, and action dynamics. The remaining
uncovered lines are generative and quantum scaffolding that returns constants

reason: Models is data-transfer objects with no behaviour. Its 14.42% line coverage is an
incidental by-product of other tests constructing those objects, not evidence of
anything, and 0% branch coverage simply reflects that there are no branches to
cover. A floor here would measure nothing.
